privacy_minimization_note: Retain only the bounded search-trace evidence needed to reconstruct action-changing result sets. Avoid storing raw typed queries or identifiable search histories longer than the published policy requires.
ranking_current_state_rules: Current official pages, signed notices, current FAQ entries, and current office/help destinations outrank superseded PDFs, archived notices, and stale fragments for action-changing voter questions.
suggestion_policy_note: Suggestions use current plain-language voter terms and route high-impact topics toward the current official page or office/help lane. Suggestions do not invent jurisdiction-specific legal conclusions.
superseded_result_behavior: Superseded or archived pages are visibly marked and demoted or excluded from ordinary public results when they no longer control.
